description:
Lee Yoonhae, a first-year college student, is a gay man secretly in love with a male classmate. But his hidden feelings are accidentally discovered by another classmate, Cha Geonhyeok.

*“Want to sleep with me?”*

Unable to refuse Geonhyeok’s proposal, Yoonhae ends up in a casual arrangement where the two have sex about once a week. As they spend more time together, Yoonhae opens up to Geonhyeok about his crush in detail and asks for help in getting closer to him. Though annoyed, Geonhyeok starts helping him anyway.

*“What are you going to do knowing that?”  
“I have dinner plans.”*

But suddenly, Geonhyeok’s attitude changes, and he begins avoiding Yoonhae. From that point on, Yoonhae finds himself thinking more about Geonhyeok than his original crush…

Will Yoonhae’s unrequited love ever come true?
